results.title: Egypt's Sisi says they are ready to defend Saudi Arabia
results.description: Egyptian President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi said on Saturday that Cairo is prepared to take any action requested by Saudi Arabia to safeguard its security and sovereignty.

results.title: In Photos | Gyanesh Kumar Resignation Protests Spread From Delhi To Hyderabad, Srinagar
results.description: Demonstrators took to the streets in New Delhi, Hyderabad and Srinagar on Saturday, October 17, over demands including the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. In New Delhi, Justice Morcha members, students and youth activists marched from the Press Club of India to Jantar Mantar under the banner ‘Reclaim Jantar Mantar’, while police detained demonstrators. Student activists were also detained during a protest in Hyderabad. In Srinagar, Congress workers protested against the election chief and an administrative officer accused of abusing a female colleague. Women in Delhi separately marched against alleged police brutality against women protesters.

results.title: Scuffles break out as protesters rally across France, joining students
results.description: PARIS (AP) — Scuffles broke out Saturday in Paris between police and small groups of protesters joining a march as part of nationwide demonstrations against rising living costs and in support of high school students’ grievances.

results.title: 'No Kings' movement seeks to boost early voting
results.description: As Americans begin casting their ballots in the midterm elections, the prominent "No Kings" anti-Trump movement is organizing thousands of rallies Saturday to get voters fired up.
